aiVerification.summary: Comparable evidence exists, but the draft misstates the primary changed factor and leaves key paired outcomes unresolved.
issues: Primary change should be normal lot/frame vs new vendor POPS VINA, not model vs Normal.
Changed condition and baseline labels are inconsistent and include a typo as a condition.
Review title is taken from a Sheet1 header instead of the validation report title.
Array Frame and Spot welding comparisons are not judged despite normal comparators.
Evidence set omits key title, purpose, compare-normal, and decision rows.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new frame vendor POPS VINA versus normal lot/frame.
Normalize condition labels while preserving any source typo as row text context.
Use Test report title and purpose/content rows for review title and purpose.
Judge Array Frame, Spot welding, and Function under one validation case.
Add Test!2, Test!6, Test!9, Test!10, and Test!43-Test!45 as supporting evidence.
